what: B1 refit sources: the source files of the final chain that the export lacks or holds in other bytes (refit-src/<repo path>) and the versions of one held step at a path where the final chain ran other bytes (refit-pins/<unit>/files/<repo path>). release/make_refit_tree.py lays them over a copy of the export source. Each file is the version that ran; the shipped bytes differ from it only by these rules (field rules; field reason gives the cause): roots (the path roots), hand (exact edits), r2-ids and json (challenge row IDs out of code and records), release-rewrite (the release rewrite of the same file), merge (a three-way merge with the export version keeps its changes since the merge base), export-copy (an export copy holds the release rewrite of the same bytes) and repin (a cited SHA-256 of a changed file gets its shipped value).
